content.architecture_note: IMPORTANT: honeycombs/registry/index.json is the MANIFEST of the registry honeycomb (describes identity, meta, resonance). The CENTRAL REGISTRY is honeycombs/registry/registry.json (generated by scanner, contains the list of all honeycombs). Do NOT expect index.json to contain the honeycomb list. This is NOT a desynchronization  it is architectural separation.

meta.goal: Compare central registry (registry.json) with actual honeycombs and report discrepancies
